functions.description: Extract base fields: timestamp, host, pid, optional severity, component, and message from settingsd log line
Extract source IP (IPv4 or IPv6) when message includes a 'from <ip>' clause
Extract username from messages referencing a quoted user
Normalize severity default, classify action type, and derive event time

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/authenticated successfully/) ? 'login_success' : message.match(/Authentication failed/) ? 'login_failure' : message.match(/Successfully applied|Applied setting|Applied bulk|updated from/) ? 'config_change' : message.match(/Failed to apply|Failed to write/) ? 'config_change_failure' : message.match(/Persisted setting|Snapshot of host configuration|Configuration reload/) ? 'config_store' : message.match(/Repeated failed attempts/) ? 'brute_force_detected' : 'other'
